complete_input_instruction_count: Matches immutable full-input instruction total only; no historical cycles or qualification inherited
scope: Same new binary and full input; compare this single-factor MQ2 or RG1 mode against its same mode OFF only. No cross-binary anchor or combined mechanisms.

service_counter_semantics.MQ2_bypasses: Actual safe second-entry lower enqueues; not application cycles saved.
service_counter_semantics.MQ2_wb_bank_waits: Sum of failed WB lower_ready observations, recorded only when MQ2 enabled; OFF zero is disabled observation, not proof of zero baseline stalls.
service_counter_semantics.RG1_physical_services: Sum of actual bank grants, observed also when RG1 OFF.
service_counter_semantics.RG1_recovered_grants: Actual selected physical bank services, not a counterfactual application-cycle saving.
service_counter_semantics.RG1_wait_ready_cycles: Per-bank cycle observations only while RG1 enabled; banks/slices overlap. OFF zeros do not establish absence of blocked-ready opportunities.
service_counter_semantics.client_maxima: Maximum native timestamp lag over clients/slices; no summation.
service_counter_semantics.native_cycle_delta: Only the matched complete same-binary/mode OFF versus ON terminals establish the signed application-cycle difference.
